title: formatify
description: Formatify is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that automates the application of color codes and text styles to user chat messages
body:
**Formatify** is a Fabric mod designed for Minecraft versions 1.21.x. Its primary function is to automatically prepend specified color and formatting codes to outgoing chat messages. This mod eliminates the need for manual input of formatting codes before transmitting each message.


Commands Usage
Configuration is handled entirely in-game via local chat commands.

> - **.text** : Displays a list of available commands and usage instructions in the local chat.
> - **.text <format>** : Applies a specific formatting code. The format must consist of the ampersand symbol ("&") followed by valid Minecraft color or formatting characters. Example: .text &c&l applies light red and bold formatting.
> - **.text random** : Enables randomization mode. Each subsequent message will feature a unique, randomly selected color and style combination.
> - **.text reset** : Disables all automated formatting. Messages will be transmitted in their default state.

Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
